description: Read the community events received since vk_events_listen, oldest first. Pass the returned cursor as after next time to get only new ones. With wait (up to 25 seconds) it holds until something arrives — call it in a loop to follow the community, e.g. to answer each new comment.

after.description: Cursor from the previous call; events after it are returned (default: all received)

wait.description: Seconds to wait for an event when there is none yet (0–25, default 0)

name: vk_events_get

cursor.description: Pass as after to get only newer events

events.description: Events, oldest first; object is what VK sent for that type

listening.description: Whether events are still being received

missed.description: Events after the cursor that were dropped from the buffer before being read

more.description: Whether more events wait after this page

stopped_because.description: Why listening ended, when it has

title: Read community events
